text: Cursor passthrough 是面向 DSH Web 的模型接入插件，在聊天模型选择器中注册独立的「Cursor 直通」组，选中后由本机 Cursor CLI/ACP 处理对话，其他模型组仍使用 DSH 原有适配器。插件提供开关、模型组状态提示和会话标记；新启动的 Cursor 会话会接收已有 DSH 对话作为上下文，后续轮次发送最新用户文本。会话标题与压缩由本地逻辑生成。适合希望在 DSH 中切换到已登录 Cursor CLI 的用户。使用前需安装 Cursor CLI 并登录，且同一 profile 需安装 dsh-cursor-acp 与 ACP SDK。

Cursor passthrough adds a Cursor group to the DSH Web model picker. Selecting it routes chats through local Cursor CLI via ACP; other picks use DSH adapters. A toggle and badge show its state. New sessions receive prior chat context. Requires a signed-in Cursor CLI and ACP dependencies.
想把 DSH 聊天切换到本机已登录的 Cursor CLI。
能不能在模型选择器里加一个 Cursor 对话入口？
I want to route selected DSH chat turns through my local Cursor CLI.
Cursor passthrough 的功能「Cursor 模型组」：在 DSH Web 聊天模型选择器注册 Cursor 直通组；选中该组后，聊天流由本机 Cursor ACP 会话处理，未选中或关闭时沿用 DSH 模型适配器。
Cursor passthrough 的功能「开关与状态提示」：设置页提供启用开关，并在聊天输入区显示当前是否选用 Cursor 直通的标记；关闭后移除模型组并释放活动会话。
Cursor passthrough 使用前须知：选中该模型组时，对话提示会交给本机 Cursor CLI 的 ACP 会话；代码未指定服务端点。（见 lib/index.js:384-387、lib/index.js:849-866）

Cursor passthrough README · dsh-cursor-passthrough：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A community plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It adds a **Cursor 直通** group to the chat model picker. Select that group and the web UI sends the turn to the **Cursor CLI** already signed in on this machine. Pick Paratera, DeepSeek, or another DSH model and those APIs run as usual.

Cursor passthrough README · dsh-cursor-passthrough：This is not an official Cursor product. It is also not [dsh-cursor-acp](https://github.com/loeanxi/dsh-cursor-acp): that plugin registers a `cursor_agent` **tool** while the parent chat still uses a DSH model. This plugin is a **model-picker route**.

Cursor passthrough README · Before you start：1. Install [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) and the [Cursor CLI](https://cursor.com/docs/cli/installation), then run `agent login`.
2. Install [dsh-cursor-acp](https://github.com/loeanxi/dsh-cursor-acp) in the same profile. This plugin reuses its CLI discovery helpers; it does not register `cursor_agent` itself.

Cursor passthrough README · Install：Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mingzhong15/dsh-cursor-passthrough
```

Desktop:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:mingzhong15/dsh-cursor-passthrough
```

Local checkout (what this machine uses):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-cursor-passthrough
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness after install. Remote browsers should hard-refresh (`Ctrl+Shift+R`).

Cursor passthrough README · After install：Open **Settings → Cursor 直通**.

- The toggle only controls whether **Cursor 直通** appears in the model picker.
- Chat turns go through Cursor **only when that group is selected**. Other picks still use Paratera / DeepSeek / Zen.
- The composer shows a badge: green when the session is on Cursor passthrough.

Which Cursor model to spawn (`--model`) is the row you pick inside **Cursor 直通**. The Cursor subagent settings page still only affects `cursor_agent`.

Cursor passthrough README · How it works：When the selected provider is `cursor`, the host intercepts `llm/stream` and runs `agent acp` on this machine. DSH model adapters are not called for that turn. Session title and compaction for Cursor sessions are local stubs, so they also skip DSH APIs.
